name: Infeasibility Kernel Definition
description: I replaced the explicit structural description of the required subset (a 3-clique/triangle) with a functional property of the subset. Instead of telling the model to find three items where all pairs are constrained, the prompt asks for three items that cannot be partitioned into two conflict-free sets. The model must deduce that this functional requirement (non-2-colorability of a 3-vertex subgraph) is mathematically equivalent to finding a triangle.
